text_block_list.name: College Student A
text_block_list.text: Who do you all think is gonna win today's Tenno Sho (Autumn)!?

text_block_list.name: College Student A
text_block_list.text:
"For me, it's gotta be Gentile-chan!
Sure, her last race was a bit uncharacteristic,
but she's still the strongest active runner, right? ♡"

text_block_list.name: College Student B
text_block_list.text:
"I'm backing Fenomeno, the Tenno Sho (Spring) Umamusume!
She's been on fire lately!
Plus, her whole vibe and look is super cool!"

text_block_list.name: College Student C
text_block_list.text:
There's the girl Lady Fuji Kiseki is rooting for, plus Epiphaneia is here too...
What a stacked lineup of talent~

text_block_list.name: College Student B
text_block_list.text: Ah, Epi, you know...—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
—Epiphaneia... she's strong, but,
it feels like she's kinda lost the momentum
she had back in the Classic year...

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Epi-san...
...I can believe in you and follow your lead,
right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Racing fans closely follow every move the Umamusume make. Epiphaneia's hesitation was palpable even to those around her.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
“—Can't be helped!
I really was hesitating, after all!”
choice_data_list: Not now... that's not it, huh.
Not now... that's not it, is it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is no hesitation or sorrow in Epiphaneia's expression right now.
Rather, compared to before—
she looks radiant.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm not hesitating anymore!
Fate loves me—
and I'm downright certain of it!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
To make everyone feel destiny...
I need to show my presence once again!
choice_data_list: Our rivals this time are the perfect opponents
Our rivals this time are the perfect opponents, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If you can triumph over both the girls you ran against at the Takarazuka Kinen and these new formidable foes,
you'll surely become the most talked-about Umamusume once again."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's right!
...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...This is your first target race since the voice of destiny changed, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Things definitely won't go like they usually do.
That's why... I'm feeling a little restless!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everything accumulated up to this point hasn't changed.
Even while hesitating, as long as one keeps moving forward—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I hear your "absolute" loud and clear!!
I'm gonna go win this!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Epiphaneia-san.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Gentil!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You are beautiful today as well!
The aura surrounding you is sparkling so brilliantly!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, I came to see your downcast face...
but it seems I'm too late.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Still, I too... showed a less than perfect
performance at the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: “However, worry not. This overflowing power…… I have polished it anew.”

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —You feel the same way, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I can see it. The sheer power coursing
through your body... the tautness of your muscles—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Please, give it everything you've got.
I think I'll quite enjoy it if it's with you.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha, that sent chills down my spine!
I see, so this too is destiny...!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case—
I can't let myself look pathetic any longer!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Gentil, of course I'll entertain you!
And on top of that—"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I'll beat you and clothe myself in absolute confidence!!
